ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "A Primer to Genome Science" - The goal of this reading group is to discuss/teach current approaches and methodologies in genome science. This is an introductory reading group for people who are new to the area. Topics to be covered include (1) genome projects, (2) gene sequencing and annotation, (3) genomic variation, (4) gene expression and the transcriptome, (5) proteomics and functional genomics, and (6) Integrative genomics. Note that this is a discussion group - not a lecture course. Restricted to students with Graduate class standing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate class standing.
